semantics.definition: A list and the page for what is chosen in it, laid out by the window class, with WhenOnePane and WhenTwoPanes to show something in only one of the two layouts.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one panes every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Lay out a list beside its page where the window is wide, and the page alone where it is not.

window.one: one pane: the page fills the window
window.two: two panes side by side, the list a third of the width
